create_oracle_pvm_env: create an OraclePVM environment instance for simulating personalized value model tuning with default parameters
reset_oracle_pvm: reset the OraclePVM environment to generate new random user and candidate document features
step_oracle_pvm: step the OraclePVM environment with weight action vector and get Kendall-Tau reward
get_scores_oracle_pvm: compute score matrix from user features and document features using hidden score functions
get_ranking_oracle_pvm: compute candidate ranking by weighting scores and sorting by descending weighted sum
